reason: I've already got my Fresha booking page and a free Wix site that does the job, so £655 for a new website plus £109 a month for a bot feels like money I don't need to spend. If I did want one, someone in my Facebook group would know a local person who'd do it cheaper.
objection: They're in Kuwait with no past clients to show, and they want half the money up front by PayPal. If it goes wrong I've no idea who I'd chase, and what I've got already works well enough.
would_change_my_mind: A few real UK small businesses like mine recommending them in the group, and a much cheaper starter site, around £300, paid mostly after it's live.
